test_title: PYST 4: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

Some Pomegranates are Peaches.

Some Peaches are Lemons.

All Lemons are Figs.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Peaches are Figs.

(II) Some Pomegranates are Figs.
solution:
**Given Statements:**

Some Pomegranates are Peaches.
Some Peaches are Lemons.
All Lemons are Figs.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e1bc882d997db93be8b97f9b5ae09388fa6fadf74a4b26671ffd5cd9841954c.png] 

*]:pointer-events-auto scroll-mt-[calc(var(--header-height)+min(200px,max(70px,20svh)))]" data-scroll-anchor="true" data-testid="conversation-turn-10" data-turn="assistant" data-turn-id="request-WEB:f49737d5-c445-441d-a3c9-6795d3aaa2c1-25" dir="auto" tabindex="-1">

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Peaches are Figs – **True** (Because some Peaches are Lemons and all Lemons are Figs, so those Peaches that are Lemons are also Figs).

II. Some Pomegranates are Figs – **False** (Because the given statements do not guarantee that the Pomegranates that overlap with Peaches are the same Peaches that overlap with Lemons/Figs).

So, **Only conclusion I follows**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
